text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but I should not trim a position just to lock in gains; base trades on its future prospects and the portfolio’s overall risk.","My average cost and the pain or pleasure of realized results can distort judgment. I should assess every holding forward-looking and avoid letting loss aversion or the urge to take profits dictate trades.","The account has risen overall, but a short record cannot establish that my decisions are sound. I should follow a consistent process, maintain diversification, and size purchases within my risk tolerance."]}
